rootCause: Repository evidence was retrieved through browser tabs even though authenticated CLI and local Git satisfied that capability.
The routing transaction lacked a browser-operation receipt binding necessity, baseline ownership, transient-tab limits, actions, and cleanup.
prohibitedClaims: Do not infer which actor closed a stale handle.
Do not close an owner-existing or ownership-unknown tab.
Do not call a cleanup successful without baseline and cleanup receipts.
